name: North Carolina Department of Commerce
source_citation: NC Department of Commerce Strategic Economic Framework 2025-2029 (NC OSBM)
mission: To enhance the economic well-being and quality of life for all North Carolinians through high-impact job creation, rural community investment, and workforce innovation.

goals.title: Universal High-Speed Broadband & Digital Inclusion
goals.description: Deploy BEAD and state broadband funds to connect 100% of unserved and underserved rural households, farms, and businesses to high-speed fiber infrastructure.
objectives: Deploy last-mile fiber to 250,000 unserved rural households and agricultural operations
Provide affordable digital devices and subsidized connectivity for low-income families
Support digital literacy and workforce digital upskilling in public libraries and community centers

goals.title: Advanced Manufacturing & Clean Energy Workforce Reskilling
goals.description: Align NC community college workforce training with emerging mega-site employers in EV batteries, semiconductors, clean tech, and aerospace.
objectives: Create customized registered apprenticeship pipelines for advanced manufacturing clusters
Fund modern high-tech laboratory equipment at rural community colleges
Retrain displaced agricultural and legacy manufacturing workers for high-wage clean energy careers

goals.title: Distressed Rural Main Street & Small Business Revitalization
goals.description: Catalyze commercial revitalization in historic downtowns, provide micro-lending and technical assistance to minority and women entrepreneurs, and develop regional industrial megasites.
objectives: Distribute downtown facade improvement and commercial building rehabilitation grants
Expand revolving loan funds for underserved Main Street merchants and tech startups
Support certified industrial shovel-ready sites in Tier 1 economically distressed counties

goals.title: Global Supply Chain Localization & Export Promotion
goals.description: Support small and medium-sized NC manufacturers entering international trade and localize critical supply chains within North Carolina.
objectives: Provide STEP export vouchers for rural manufacturers to attend international trade expos
Establish regional supply chain supplier-matching databases for major state industrial anchors
Modernize agricultural value-added processing and cold storage facilities
